name: net
description: The Doom Scroll Antidote — scan the internet for what you care about, know what you've read

scripts.build: tsc && node -e "const fs=require('fs');const cp=require('child_process');const h=cp.execSync('git rev-parse --short HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo dev').toString().trim();const f='public/index.html';fs.writeFileSync(f,fs.readFileSync(f,'utf8').replace(/BUILD_HASH/g,h))"
